advancement.fealty.bandit_followers.desc: Hire a bandit to fight for you.
advancement.fealty.courier.desc: Deliver a sealed letter to another village's elder.
advancement.fealty.defender.desc: Help a village win a raid.
advancement.fealty.guild_member.desc: Take a job from the thieves guild.
advancement.fealty.met_elder.desc: Speak with a village's trusting elder.
advancement.fealty.redemption.desc: Climb back out of disgrace through the elder's quests.
advancement.fealty.restored: The Elder Is Dead, Long Live the Elder
advancement.fealty.restored.desc: Raise a new elder for a Broken village.
advancement.fealty.root.desc: Every village remembers how you treat it.
advancement.fealty.royal_writ.desc: Join the Signet and the Charter into a Royal Writ.
advancement.fealty.rumours.desc: Ask a village elder about the old rumours.
advancement.fealty.sworn_lord.desc: Have a village swear fealty to you.
advancement.fealty.threatened.desc: Threaten a villager into a fair price.
advancement.fealty.tribute.desc: Collect tribute from a village you rule.
advancement.fealty.unseen_theft.desc: Steal from a village without being seen.
advancement.fealty.usurper.desc: Take a village from another lord.
advancement.fealty.village_broken.desc: Leave a village without its elder.
advancement.fealty.wanted.desc: Have a price put on your head.
fealty.bandit.deserted: %s wants no part of an outlaw gone soft, and leaves you.
fealty.bandit.hired: %s takes your emeralds and falls in behind you.
fealty.bandit.not_infamous: "You? Work for you? Come back when the villages fear your name."
fealty.bandit.too_many: You can't feed any more mouths.
fealty.black_market.refused: "Never seen you before. Honest folk buy honest goods. Go."
fealty.bounty.dispatched: Bounty hunters from %s are on your trail!
fealty.bounty.slain: The bounty hunter falls. Someone will send another.
fealty.chain.charter: The Keeper gives you a charter. Bring it, and the Signet, back to them.
fealty.chain.hint.combine: Bring the Signet and the Charter to the Keeper.
fealty.chain.hint.hamlet: Follow the map to the hidden hamlet near %s, %s.
fealty.chain.hint.steps: Help the named villagers (%s of %s done).
fealty.chain.map_given: With the last piece, you are given the Signet and a map to a hidden hamlet. The Keeper lives there.
fealty.chain.no_hamlet: Nobody knows where the hamlet lies any more. (No hidden hamlet could be found.)
fealty.chain.rumours_locked: Only those the village holds %s hear the old rumours.
fealty.chain.rumours_told: The elder lowers their voice: "There are old stories of a crown, and someone who still keeps its secret. Speak with %s. They know more."
fealty.chain.step_done: One more piece of the story falls into place. %s left.
fealty.chain.subtitle: Of %s
fealty.chain.villager.done: "I've told you all I know. Find the others, and finish it."
fealty.chain.villager.greet.cartographer: "The old roads? I might be able to help, if you help me."
fealty.chain.villager.greet.cleric: "The Keeper? Hush. Not here. First, there is something I need done."
fealty.chain.villager.greet.smith: "So the elder sent you. Yes, I remember the old seal..."
fealty.chain.villager.idle: "Hm? I don't know what you mean."
fealty.command.restore_pending: %s will have a new elder the next time it is loaded.
fealty.command.village_info: %s [%s] centre %s, structure %s, elder %s, lord %s, tax level %s
fealty.dialogue.broken.0: Our elder is dead. Who will speak for us now?
fealty.dialogue.broken.1: Nothing is the same since the elder fell.
fealty.dialogue.broken.2: They say a neighbouring elder could name a new one...
fealty.dialogue.broken.3: We are lost without our elder.
fealty.dialogue.hated.1: Murderer. Thief. Whatever you are, leave.
fealty.dialogue.hated.2: The guards will hear of this.
fealty.dialogue.hated.3: We have nothing for you here.
fealty.dialogue.honored.0: %s! The whole village is glad you're here.
fealty.dialogue.honored.1: Take this, please. For all you've done.
fealty.dialogue.honored.2: My children tell stories about you.
fealty.dialogue.lord.2: The harvest is good this year, my lord.
fealty.dialogue.trusted.0: Ah, it's you! Good to see you.
fealty.dialogue.trusted.1: Come by the hall later, there's bread.
fealty.dialogue.trusted.2: The elder speaks well of you.
fealty.elder.greet.distrusted: "You are not welcome, %s, but you are not beyond redemption. Help %s and we may yet think better of you."
fealty.elder.greet.hated: "So you dare come here, %s. If you would mend what you have broken, there are tasks only the desperate would take."
fealty.elder.greet.honored: "%s! %s owes you more than it can repay. Sit, tell me your news."
fealty.elder.greet.neutral: "Welcome to %2$s, traveller. We could use a willing pair of hands."
fealty.elder.greet.trusted: "Ah, %s, a friend of %s. What can I do for you?"
fealty.elder.lost: The elder looks at you blankly. They seem to have forgotten their own village.
fealty.elder.subtitle: Elder of %s
fealty.fence.completed: "You're a guild thief now. Wear it well."
fealty.fence.done: "You're one of us now. Nothing more to teach you."
fealty.fence.recruit: "Word gets around, %s. The guild could use someone like you. Interested?"
fealty.fence.refused: "I don't know what you're talking about. Move along."
fealty.fence.step_done: "Not bad. Here, you've earned this. Come back for the next job."
fealty.fence.subtitle: The Thieves Guild
fealty.gift.cooldown: %s has already accepted a gift from you today.
fealty.gift.not_enough: %s takes the gift, but it will take more than gifts to mend what you did.
fealty.gift.received: %s presses a gift into your hands.
fealty.guard.escort_refused: %s does not take orders from you.
fealty.guard.escort_start: %s will escort you for a while.
fealty.guard.warning: %s: "Halt! Do that again and we will cut you down."
fealty.guard.watching.0: %s: "Keep your hands where I can see them."
fealty.guard.watching.2: %s: "Mind yourself. We remember what you did."
fealty.horn.no_village: You rule no village whose guards could answer.
fealty.keeper.combine: "You have done all I asked. Give me the Signet and the Charter."
fealty.keeper.combine_action: Join the Signet and the Charter
fealty.keeper.combine_missing: You need the Signet of the Old Crown and the Keeper's Charter.
fealty.keeper.done: "Go now. A village awaits its lord."
fealty.keeper.fallen: "Your name has fallen in %s. I do not deal with those their own people distrust. Mend it with the elder there, then return."
fealty.keeper.forged: The Keeper binds signet and charter into a Royal Writ. "Present it to the elder of a village that honours you. They will swear fealty."
fealty.keeper.stranger: "I don't know you, stranger. There is nothing here for you. Go."
fealty.keeper.subtitle: Keeper of the Old Crown
fealty.keeper.trial_active: "You have your task. Go, and come back when it is done."
fealty.keeper.trial_offer: "So %s still trusts you. Good. Prove yourself to me as well."
fealty.ledger.empty: You have not yet made a name with any village. Visit one and its people will remember you.
fealty.ledger.title: Fealty Ledger
fealty.lord.lost: The people of %s have renounced their fealty to you.
fealty.lord.new_horn: Ask for a new Lord's Horn
fealty.lord.problem.broken: A Broken village cannot swear fealty.
fealty.lord.problem.loved_lord: %s rules here, and the people love them more than you.
fealty.lord.problem.not_honored: Only a village that holds you %s will swear fealty to you.
fealty.lord.problem.too_many: You already rule as many villages as you can hold (%s).
fealty.lord.sworn: The people of %s swear fealty to %s!
fealty.lord.sworn_self: You are now the lord of %s. Its tribute will gather in the village coffer, and its guards answer your horn.
fealty.lord.tribute: Tribute from %s has been paid into the village coffer (%s measures).
fealty.pickpocket.empty: %s has nothing left worth taking today.
fealty.quest.already_active: You are already on a quest for them. Finish or abandon it first.
fealty.quest.clear_camp.line: Defeat the captain of the bandit camp near %s, %s
fealty.quest.clear_camp.none: There are no bandit camps anywhere near.
fealty.quest.courier.delivered: You hand over the letter from %s. The elder of %s breaks the seal and nods.
fealty.quest.courier.line: Deliver the sealed letter to the elder of %s (near %s, %s)
fealty.quest.courier.none: There is nowhere to send a letter to.
fealty.quest.courier.preview: Carry a sealed letter to another village's elder
fealty.quest.defend_raid.fighting: The raid is upon the village. Drive them off!
fealty.quest.defend_raid.gathering: A raid is gathering. Stay in the village and be ready.
fealty.quest.defend_raid.no_raid: No raiders will come here now (peaceful difficulty, or raids are disabled).
fealty.quest.defend_raid.preview: Hold the village through a raid
fealty.quest.failed.giver_lost: Quest failed, the quest giver is gone: %s
fealty.quest.not_ready: You do not have what the quest needs yet.
fealty.quest.pickpocket.line: Pick %s pockets unseen (%s/%s). Sneak up behind a villager with an empty hand.
fealty.quest.ready: %s is done. Return to hand it in.
fealty.quest.rebuild.line: Clear the rubble near %s, %s, %s and put the right blocks back (%s/%s)
fealty.quest.rebuild.nothing: Nothing here needs rebuilding right now.
fealty.quest.rebuild.preview: Rebuild %s damaged blocks of a building
fealty.quest.rebuild.unloaded: Come back when you can see the village properly.
fealty.quest.rebuild.wrong: That doesn't belong there. It was %s.
fealty.quest.restore.none: No village nearby needs an elder.
fealty.quest.restore.preview: Restore the elder of a Broken village
fealty.quest.restore.stage0: Gather the makings of an elder's mantle for %s:
fealty.quest.restore.stage1: Take the Elder's Mantle to %s (near %s, %s) and place it on a villager there (sneak + use).
fealty.quest.steal.bring: Bring the goods to the fence.
fealty.quest.steal.seen: You were seen. The guild wants it done quietly.
fealty.quest.vault_raid.line: Empty %s village coffers without being seen (%s/%s). You'll need a lockpick.
fealty.renown.fall: Your %s falls: you are known as %s across the land.
fealty.renown.rise: Your %s rises: you are known as %s across the land.
fealty.screen.no_quests: There is nothing more to ask of you today.
fealty.threat.cowers: %s cowers: "Fine! Fine, take what you want. Just this once." (Their next trade is at the Neutral price.)
fealty.threat.refuses: %s has had enough of your threats and will not trade with you for a day.
fealty.threat.too_scared: %s is too frightened to deal with you at all.
fealty.trade.refused_hated: %s will not trade with the likes of you. (Hated: only a threat will make them.)
fealty.trade.refused_threats: %s refuses to trade with you today.
fealty.tyrant.appears: The Tyrant Lord rides out of %s to face you!
fealty.tyrant.fallen_other: Someone else has killed the Tyrant Lord.
fealty.tyrant.risen: The Tyrant Lord has seized %s (near %s, %s) and waits there for you.
fealty.tyrant.slain: %s has slain the Tyrant Lord and freed %s!
fealty.village.broken: %s, the elder of %s, is dead. The village is Broken and offers no more quests until an elder is restored.
fealty.wanted.level1: %s has put a price on your head. Bounty hunters are coming.
fealty.wanted.level2: %s has called on the Tyrant Lord to hunt you.
item.fealty.bounty_notice.desc: A price was on someone's head. Not any more.
item.fealty.elders_mantle.desc: Place it on a villager of a Broken village (sneak + use) to raise a new elder.
item.fealty.keepers_charter.desc: The Keeper's charter. Joined with the Signet, it makes a Royal Writ.
item.fealty.ledger.desc: Your standing with every village and band you have met.
item.fealty.lockpick.desc: Use it on a locked village chest or coffer to pick the lock. Every miss strains it, and someone may hear.
item.fealty.lords_horn.desc: Use anywhere to command your village's guards. Sneak and use to choose the village and order.
item.fealty.rogue_set.desc: Full set: while sneaking, witnesses only see you from half as far.
item.fealty.royal_writ.desc: Present it to the elder of a village that honours you, and its people will swear fealty to you.
item.fealty.signet_of_the_old_crown.desc: Half of an old royal seal. The Keeper holds the other half's secret.
item.fealty.smoke_bomb.desc: Throw it. For 15 seconds nobody can see into the smoke, anything hunting you there loses you, and you slip away unseen and quick.
item.fealty.tyrant_crown.desc: While worn, threatening villagers costs no reputation.
quest.fealty.bandit_menace.desc: Bandits rob our carts on the road. Find their camp and put down their captain.
quest.fealty.beast_of_the_fen.desc: Something has been taking our sheep. Hunt it down.
quest.fealty.blood_price.desc: There is only one price for what you did: something that cheats death itself.
quest.fealty.bread_for_the_hall.desc: The hall feeds the village through the lean weeks. Bring bread.
quest.fealty.chain.cartographer_survey.d: "There was a map of the old roads once. Bring me what I need to redraw it."
quest.fealty.chain.cleric_relic.desc: "The last of the old order walks again. Lay him to rest and bring me peace of mind."
quest.fealty.chain.keeper_trial.desc: "An oathbreaker haunts these woods. Defeat him, and I will know you are worthy."
quest.fealty.chain.smith_ore.desc: "The old seal had a key. I can forge another, but I need good metal."
quest.fealty.costly_amends.desc: You have done great harm. Pay for it, in diamonds and gold.
quest.fealty.guild.first_lift.desc: "Every thief starts with pockets. Pick three without anyone seeing."
quest.fealty.guild.light_fingers.desc: "Eight emeralds from village chests. Nobody sees you, or it doesn't count."
quest.fealty.guild.masterwork.desc: "Two coffers, two villages, not a soul the wiser. Then you're one of us."
quest.fealty.guild.the_strongbox.desc: "Every village keeps a coffer by its elder. Empty one, quietly."
quest.fealty.harvest_tithe.desc: The granary is low. Bring wheat and carrots for the winter stores.
quest.fealty.healers_herbs.desc: The healer needs rare things for her remedies.
quest.fealty.hold_the_walls.desc: Raiders are coming. Stand with the village when they do.
quest.fealty.last_stand.desc: A great raid gathers. Only those who hold the line will be forgiven.
quest.fealty.mend_the_walls.desc: Part of a house has crumbled. Clear the rubble and rebuild it.
quest.fealty.night_terror.desc: A horror stalks the village at night. Kill it, if you can.
quest.fealty.ore_for_the_smithy.desc: The smith needs iron and coal to keep the forge burning.
quest.fealty.outlaw_purge.desc: Prove you are not one of them. Destroy a bandit camp's captain.
quest.fealty.ravager_of_the_roads.desc: A brute of an illager waylays travellers. End it.
quest.fealty.rebuild_the_hall.desc: The hall itself lies in ruins. Rebuild it, stone by stone.
quest.fealty.restock_workshops.desc: Our craftsfolk lost their tools. Build new workstations in the village.
quest.fealty.restore_the_elder.desc: A nearby village lost its elder. Help them raise a new one.
quest.fealty.sealed_letter.desc: Carry this letter to the elder of a neighbouring village. Do not break the seal.
quest.fealty.timber_for_repairs.desc: Roofs leak and fences sag. Bring logs for the carpenters.
quest.fealty.urgent_dispatch.desc: This letter cannot wait. Deliver it within two days.
quest.fealty.wool_for_winter.desc: Winter comes early this year. Bring wool for blankets.
fealty.journal.title: Journal
fealty.journal.no_quests_hint: Village elders and villagers give work to those they trust. Talk to them to find quests. Accepted quests appear here and in the tracker.
fealty.journal.no_lordships: You rule no villages yet. Earn a Royal Writ and swear fealty with an elder to become a village's lord.
fealty.command.scan_none: No village here. Add the structure to "extra_village_structures" in the server config, or use /rep village create.
fealty.command.already_village: There is already a village here.
fealty.line.greet.hated.3: We've nothing for the likes of you.
fealty.line.greet.distrusted.0: Hmph. Keep your hands where I can see them.
fealty.line.greet.neutral.3: Mind the crops on your way through.
fealty.line.greet.trusted.2: The village speaks well of you.
fealty.line.greet.honored.2: You honour us with your visit, %s.
fealty.line.greet.broken.0: Since the elder passed, nothing feels right.
fealty.line.greet.broken.1: Without the elder, who will lead us?
fealty.line.greet.broken.2: Have you heard? The elder is gone...
fealty.line.greet.librarian.0: Have you read any good books lately?
fealty.line.greet.cleric.1: I sense a heavy heart in you.
fealty.line.greet.armorer.1: A good helm has saved many a head.
fealty.line.greet.weaponsmith.0: A blade is only as good as its wielder.
fealty.line.greet.toolsmith.0: A good pick never lets you down.
fealty.line.greet.cartographer.0: The world is bigger than you think.
fealty.line.greet.cartographer.1: I've maps to places you've never dreamed of.
fealty.line.greet.shepherd.1: Have you seen a lost sheep?
fealty.line.greet.leatherworker.1: Rabbit hide makes the softest gloves.
fealty.line.greet.nitwit.0: Have you seen my... what was I looking for?
fealty.line.greet.nitwit.1: I counted the clouds today. Seven! Or eight.
fealty.line.greet.none.1: Know anyone who needs a hand?
fealty.line.greet_child.hated.1: Mama! The bad one is here!
fealty.line.greet_child.neutral.1: Mama says not to talk to strangers.
fealty.line.greet_child.trusted.2: When I grow up I want to be like you!
fealty.line.work_none.any.1: Ask the elder; they always need help.
fealty.line.news.any.0: They say bandits camp out past the hills.
fealty.line.news.any.1: The harvest looks good this year.
fealty.line.news.any.3: A trader came by with strange goods.
fealty.line.news.any.4: Someone's been stealing from the farms.
fealty.line.news.any.5: The roads aren't safe after dark.
fealty.line.news.any.6: I heard there's a hidden village, deep in the woods.
fealty.line.news.any.7: The guards have been on edge lately.
fealty.line.crime_vandalism.any.0: What are you doing to our village?
fealty.line.crime.any.2: You won't get away with that!
fealty.line.threat_cower.any.1: Take what you want, just leave me be!
fealty.line.threat_cower.any.2: Alright, alright! A fair price, I promise!
fealty.line.threat_refuse.any.0: I'm not doing anything for you anymore!
fealty.line.refuse_hated.any.0: I won't trade with the likes of you.
fealty.line.refuse_hated.any.1: Your coin is no good here.
fealty.line.refuse_threats.any.0: After what you did? No trades for you.
fealty.line.gift_refused.any.0: Gifts won't undo what you did.
fealty.line.gift_cooldown.any.0: You already gave me something today!
fealty.line.gift_cooldown.any.1: Too kind, but I can't take more today.
fealty.line.gift_give.any.0: Here, take this. For all you've done.
fealty.line.gift_give.any.1: A little something for our hero!
fealty.dialogue.subtitle: %s · %s (%s)
fealty.dialogue.option.deliver: I have a letter for you.
fealty.dialogue.letter_thanks: Thank you for bringing this all this way.
fealty.news.wanderer: I don't belong to any village.
fealty.news.wanted: There's a price on your head, %s. Watch yourself.
fealty.news.broken: Since Elder %s died, we've had no one to lead us.
fealty.news.your_lordship: Your village is well, my lord.
quest.fealty.favor.farmer_bonemeal.desc: The soil's tired this year. Could you bring me some bone meal?
quest.fealty.favor.farmer_seeds.desc: I'm short on seed for the next sowing. Wheat seeds, if you can spare them.
quest.fealty.favor.farmer_pests.desc: Something tramples my crops at night. Zombies, I'd wager. Thin them out for me?
quest.fealty.favor.farmer_pumpkins.desc: We're planning a little feast. Two good pumpkins would make it.
quest.fealty.favor.librarian_ink.desc: My inkwell's dry and the records won't copy themselves. Ink sacs, please?
quest.fealty.favor.librarian_paper.desc: I've run out of paper. Twenty-four sheets would see me through the week.
quest.fealty.favor.librarian_ruins.desc: Travellers speak of ancient stone gates in the wilds. Would you find one and tell me of it?
quest.fealty.favor.cleric_flesh.desc: Rotten flesh makes a fine poultice, believe it or not. Bring me some?
quest.fealty.favor.cleric_glow.desc: The shrine needs light. Glowstone dust, if you can find it.
quest.fealty.favor.cleric_undead.desc: The dead walk too close to our homes. Put a few of them to rest.
quest.fealty.favor.armorer_coal.desc: The forge eats coal like a hungry dog. Sixteen lumps, please.
quest.fealty.favor.armorer_iron.desc: I'm mending the guards' mail. A few iron ingots would help.
quest.fealty.favor.weaponsmith_flint.des: Flint makes a fine whetstone. Could you gather some?
quest.fealty.favor.weaponsmith_iron.desc: A few iron ingots and I can arm the watch properly.
quest.fealty.favor.toolsmith_stone.desc: Handles and heads, that's all a tool is. Sticks and cobblestone, please.
quest.fealty.favor.toolsmith_iron.desc: Everyone wants a new pick. I need iron.
quest.fealty.favor.fisherman_cod.desc: My back's acting up and the cod won't catch themselves.
quest.fealty.favor.fisherman_string.desc: My nets are torn. String, and plenty of it.
quest.fealty.favor.cartographer_wreck.de: Sailors say there's a wreck along the coast. Find it so I can mark it on my charts.
quest.fealty.favor.cartographer_portal.d: There's a ruined gate somewhere near. Find it and I'll put it on the map.
quest.fealty.favor.cartographer_glass.de: I'm grinding new lenses. Glass panes, if you have them.
quest.fealty.favor.shepherd_wool.desc: A storm scattered my fleeces. White wool to replace them?
quest.fealty.favor.shepherd_dye.desc: The weavers want colour. Any dyes will do.
quest.fealty.favor.shepherd_wolves.desc: Wolves have been taking my lambs. Drive them off. Please.
quest.fealty.favor.butcher_coal.desc: The smokehouse needs coal to keep going.
quest.fealty.favor.butcher_beef.desc: Business is good, stock is low. Raw beef, if you're hunting anyway.
quest.fealty.favor.mason_clay.desc: I need clay to fire new bricks.
quest.fealty.favor.mason_stone.desc: The walls won't mend themselves. Thirty-two stone, please.
quest.fealty.favor.fletcher_feathers.des: You can never have too many feathers. Well, I can't.
quest.fealty.favor.fletcher_flint.desc: Flint for arrowheads, and I'll owe you one.
quest.fealty.favor.leatherworker_leather: Saddles and satchels need leather. Eight hides?
Rabbit hide makes the softest gloves. Bring me some?
quest.fealty.favor.nitwit_poppy.desc: I lost my lucky flower! It was red. A poppy! Find me a poppy?
quest.fealty.favor.nitwit_shiny.desc: I collect shiny things. Gold nuggets are the shiniest. Got any?
fealty.talk.nitwit_hello: Your neighbour wanted me to say hello.
fealty.talk.nitwit_hello.reply: Hello? Oh, that one. Tell them hello back, I suppose.
quest.fealty.favor.nitwit_hello.desc: Tell the farmer I said hello! They never listen to me.
quest.fealty.favor.nitwit_slime.desc: There's a monster in the well! Or near it. Somewhere. Kill a zombie, just in case?
quest.fealty.favor.drifter_bread.desc: I haven't eaten since yesterday. Could you spare some bread?
fealty.talk.drifter_work: Do you need an extra pair of hands? There's someone looking for work.
fealty.talk.drifter_work.reply: Could do. Send them my way.
quest.fealty.favor.drifter_work.desc: I need work. Would you ask the smith if they need a hand?
fealty.talk.any_message: I've a message for you from a neighbour.
fealty.talk.any_message.reply: Ah, thank you. I'll see to it.
quest.fealty.favor.any_message.desc: Would you carry a message for me? It's just across the village.
quest.fealty.favor.any_firewood.desc: The nights are cold. Sixteen logs would keep my hearth going.
quest.fealty.favor.any_torches.desc: Monsters come out where it's dark. Torches, to light the lanes?
quest.fealty.favor.any_locket.desc: I dropped my grandmother's locket on the road and it's gone. I marked where on this map. Would you look?
quest.fealty.favor.any_apples.desc: I promised a pie and I'm short of apples.
quest.fealty.night_watch.desc: The dead come at night and our guards are few. Stand watch and cut them down near the village.
quest.fealty.wolves_in_the_woods.desc: A pack has taken three sheep this month. Hunt them before they take a child.
quest.fealty.spider_nest.desc: Spiders crawl over the walls at night. Clear them from around the village.
quest.fealty.pillager_scouts.desc: Pillagers have been seen watching the roads. Deal with their scouts before they bring an army.
quest.fealty.lost_shipment.desc: Our cart never came back from market. Find it, and the goods it carried.
quest.fealty.stolen_heirloom.desc: Bandits took the village's old signet ring. Their stash is marked on this map. Bring it home.
quest.fealty.buried_tithe.desc: In the old war, the village hid its tithe in the hills. This map shows where. Recover it.
quest.fealty.survey_the_ruins.desc: There are ruins near here we know nothing about. Go and see them, then tell me what you found.
fealty.talk.errand: The elder would like a word with you.
fealty.talk.errand.reply: Does the elder now? Tell them I'll be along.
quest.fealty.errand_for_the_elder.desc: Run along and tell the armorer I'd like a word. It's a small thing, but small things build trust.
quest.fealty.atonement_hunt.desc: You want to make amends? Then bleed for us. Twenty of the walking dead, near our walls, by night.
quest.fealty.return_what_was_taken.desc: Bandits stole from us, and some say you helped them. Prove otherwise: bring back what they took.
fealty.talk.bread: The village sent me. Everyone hopes you get well soon.
fealty.talk.bread.reply: Bless you. Tell the elder we're grateful.
quest.fealty.kind_words.desc: The farmer's family has been ill. Go and tell them the whole village is thinking of them.
fealty.line.favor_accepted.any.0: Thank you! Come back when it's done.
fealty.line.favor_accepted.any.2: I knew I could count on you, %s.
fealty.line.favor_thanks.any.2: Exactly what I needed. Thank you!
fealty.line.favor_not_yet.any.1: Not yet, I'm afraid. Come back when you have it all.
fealty.objective.vault_raid: Raid coffers in different villages, unseen
fealty.objective.raid_wait: Wait at the village for the raid
fealty.objective.raid_fight: Defend the village from the raid
fealty.objective.restore_mantle: Hand them to the elder for the Mantle
fealty.objective.talk_to.message: I bring a message for you.
fealty.objective.talk_to.reply: Thank you for letting me know.
fealty.quest.explore.none: There is no %s anywhere near here.
fealty.quest.talk_to.none: There is no one here to take the message.
fealty.quest.talk_to.preview: Carry a message to someone in the village
fealty.quest.too_many: You already have %s quests. Finish or abandon one first.
fealty.screen.abandon_hint: Abandoning a quest may cost reputation
fealty.dialogue.option.favor_done: I have what you asked for.
fealty.favor.accepted: Thank you! Come back when it's done.
quest.fealty.chain.smith_forge.desc: "The old seal was cast in a hotter fire than mine. Bring me fuel that burns like a dragon's breath, and iron to feed it."
quest.fealty.chain.smith_die.desc: "My father's cart carried the old die, the one that struck the crown's seal. Brigands overturned it on the road. Find it."
"There was a royal watchtower on the old road. Pillagers hold it now. Get close enough to see the crest on its stones."
quest.fealty.chain.cartographer_lost_cha: "My master buried his last chart rather than let the usurper's men take it. This is where."
quest.fealty.chain.cleric_vigil.desc: "Keep vigil with me. The dead rise thick on the nights the old crown is spoken of. Put twelve of them to rest within sight of the bell."
quest.fealty.chain.cleric_rite.desc: "The rite of the crown needs a golden offering, and candles enough to light the way."
quest.fealty.chain.librarian_chronicle.d: "Pages were torn from the chronicle. I can write them again from memory, but I need books and ink."
quest.fealty.chain.librarian_ruins.desc: "The chronicle speaks of gates of black stone the old court used. A ruin of one lies near. See it with your own eyes."
quest.fealty.chain.librarian_stolen_book: "Bandits took the third volume, thinking it worth gold. It is worth more. Their stash is marked here."
fealty.chain.villager.greet.librarian: "The chronicle of the old crown? Few ask after it. Fewer should."
quest.fealty.chain.farmer_harvest.desc: "Help me bring the harvest in, and I'll sing you the old song my grandmother sang. It names a place."
quest.fealty.chain.farmer_blight.desc: "Something walks my fields at night, digging at the old barrow under the north field. Stop it."
quest.fealty.chain.farmer_seed_box.desc: "There was a wheat grown only for the old court. My father had the last box of its seed when his cart was lost."
fealty.chain.villager.greet.farmer: "Crown? I grow wheat, friend. ...Though my grandmother sang a song about it."
quest.fealty.chain.fisherman_wreck.desc: "A barge with a crowned prow sank off the coast when I was a boy. Find what is left of it."
quest.fealty.chain.fisherman_drowned.des: "The drowned took a bell from the river shrine, and they are thick in the deep water. Thin them out, and I'll tell you what the bell rang for."
quest.fealty.chain.fisherman_catch.desc: "The old festival needs fish. Help me with the catch and I'll tell you the rest over supper."
fealty.chain.villager.greet.fisherman: "You want to hear about the lights on the water? Help me first."
quest.fealty.chain.shepherd_alpha.desc: "A great grey wolf leads the pack on the high pastures. The old path to the hamlet runs through its hunting ground."
quest.fealty.chain.shepherd_banner.desc: "The old crown's banner was gold on blue. I'll weave one if you bring the wool and dyes. You'll want it where you're going."
quest.fealty.chain.shepherd_bell.desc: "My grandfather's bell-wether wore a bell stamped with a crown. When the flock was scattered, it was lost in the hills."
fealty.chain.villager.greet.shepherd: "The high pastures remember things the valley forgot. I'll tell you, for a favour."
quest.fealty.chain.butcher_feast.desc: "Fill my larder and I'll read you the old feast tally. Some of the names on it will surprise you."
quest.fealty.chain.butcher_thief.desc: "Something big has been raiding the smokehouse. A spider the size of a cart. It nests out past the fields."
fealty.talk.chain_debt: The butcher says the debt for the old feast is settled.
fealty.talk.chain_debt.reply: Settled? After forty years? Well. Then tell them this: the hamlet lies in the hills, past the two standing stones.
quest.fealty.chain.butcher_debt.desc: "The farmer's family owed mine for the last feast. I'm calling it settled. Tell them so, and listen to what they say back."
fealty.chain.villager.greet.butcher: "The old lords fed this village every winter. I keep the tally of who came. Sit, but you'll earn your supper."
quest.fealty.chain.mason_mark.desc: "I'll carve you the old crown's mark, so you'll know it when you see it. But I'll need good stone."
quest.fealty.chain.mason_shafts.desc: "The stone for the old hall came from deep workings in the hills. Find the shafts, and see if the mark is carved there."
quest.fealty.chain.mason_quarry.desc: "Skeletons haunt the quarry where the old stones were cut. Clear them, so I can go and look again."
fealty.chain.villager.greet.mason: "Every stone in this village was cut by someone. Some of them carved a mark. I know which."
quest.fealty.chain.fletcher_feathers.des: "I'll make you a sheaf in the old way, the way the crown's archers had them. Bring feathers and flint."
"A skeleton in a rotten royal tabard shoots at anyone on the east road. Whatever it guards, I want to know."
quest.fealty.chain.fletcher_bow.desc: "Bandits took my grandfather's longbow. The crown's own mark is on the grip."
fealty.chain.villager.greet.fletcher: "The crown's archers fletched with grey goose. I still do. Ask, and help."
quest.fealty.chain.tanner_hides.desc: "The chronicle's binding is rotting. I'll bind it again, and you can read what was hidden inside the cover."
quest.fealty.chain.tanner_satchel.desc: "The last royal courier fell on the road. His satchel held this village's old charter."
fealty.talk.chain_seal: Do you have the old courier's seal?
fealty.talk.chain_seal.reply: The seal? I keep it for luck. Here, show it to the tanner. It has the hamlet's sign on it.
quest.fealty.chain.tanner_seal.desc: "Ask around for me. Someone in this village still has the old courier's seal."
fealty.chain.villager.greet.tanner: "My family bound the old chronicles in leather. We kept more than books."
fealty.talk.chain_riddle: The fool asks: what wears a crown, but has no head?
fealty.talk.chain_riddle.reply: ...A hill. The crowned hill. Where did the fool hear that? There was a hamlet under the crowned hill, once.
quest.fealty.chain.fool_riddle.desc: "Tell the cleric my riddle! What wears a crown but has no head? They'll know! They always know."
quest.fealty.chain.fool_shiny.desc: "Bring me the shiniest thing in the whole world and I'll tell you a secret. A real one! Not like last time."
quest.fealty.chain.fool_troll.desc: "There's a troll under the bridge! It took my hat! Get my hat back and I'll tell you where the crown went."
fealty.chain.villager.greet.fool: "Crown, crown, who's got the crown? Hee! I know. I know! But you have to play."
quest.fealty.chain.drifter_bundle.desc: "I was robbed on the road from the hills. Get my things back and I'll show you the way I came."
quest.fealty.chain.drifter_robber.desc: "The one who robbed me still camps by the road. Crooked Wat, he calls himself."
quest.fealty.chain.drifter_boots.desc: "My boots gave out, and so did my bread. Help me and I'll tell you about the hamlet I passed."
fealty.chain.villager.greet.drifter: "I came from the hills, past a place that isn't on any map. I'll tell you, but I need help first."
quest.fealty.chain.keeper_trial_shard.de: "When the crown was broken, one shard was hidden in the wilds. Brigands found the place. Take it back from them."
"The usurper's last captain still lives, and hunts my people. End his line, and you will have my charter."
fealty.toast.chain_people: %s villagers know more. Ask them for work.
fealty.banner.signet.detail: The pieces fit. A map shows the way to a hidden hamlet.
fealty.banner.charter.detail: Bring the Signet and the Charter to the Keeper.
fealty.banner.writ.detail: Present it to the elder of a village that honours you.
fealty.line.guard_greet.lord.2: The watch stands ready, my lord.
fealty.line.guard_greet.lord.4: All quiet, my lord. Just how we like it.
fealty.line.guard_greet.honored.2: The village is safer with you here.
fealty.line.guard_greet.honored.3: If you need an escort, you need only ask.
fealty.line.guard_greet.trusted.3: Nice to see a friendly face.
fealty.line.guard_greet.neutral.1: Keep the peace and we'll get along.
fealty.line.guard_greet.distrusted.0: I've got my eye on you.
fealty.line.guard_greet.distrusted.1: One wrong move, and you'll regret it.
fealty.line.guard_greet.distrusted.2: State your business, and be quick.
fealty.line.guard_greet.night.2: Long night. Keep your blade close.
fealty.line.guard_hostile.any.2: You'll answer for what you did!
fealty.guard.dialogue.subtitle: %s of the %s watch
fealty.guard.option.escort: Would you walk with me a while?
fealty.guard.option.end_escort: That will be all, thank you.
fealty.guard.escort_hint: Only those the village honours may ask for an escort.
fealty.guard.reply.escort: It would be my honour. Lead on.
fealty.guard.report.none: I keep watch here. That's all there is to it.
fealty.guard.report.full: All %s of the watch stand ready.
fealty.guard.report.fallen: %s of %s stand watch. We lost %s; new blood will join us soon.
fealty.guard.report.your_lordship: We serve at your command, my lord.
fealty.toast.guard_fell.detail: %s of %s. A new guard will be sworn in after %s day(s).
fealty.horn.called: %s guards fall in; %s more are on their way from %s.
fealty.horn.none_answer: No guards of %s can answer the horn.
fealty.horn.ordered.guard: %s guards keep watch over this place.
fealty.horn.hint.call: Guards near you fall in behind you, and up to %s more ride out from the village to join you.
fealty.horn.hint.hold: The guards with you stay where they stand.
fealty.horn.hint.guard: The guards with you keep watch around where you stand.
fealty.horn.hint.return: The guards with you go back to the village.
fealty.horn.title: Lord's Horn
fealty.horn.none: You rule no villages yet. Earn a Royal Writ and swear an elder's fealty.
fealty.retinue.title: Retinue
quest.fealty.letter_for_a_friend.desc: One of ours has a dear friend in another village. Carry this letter to them, and put it in their hands yourself.
quest.fealty.the_post_must_go_through.de: Our letters pile up and the post rider is laid up with a fever. Take this bundle to another village and post it in their mailbox.
quest.fealty.favor.any_letter_sister.des: My sister married into another village. Would you carry a letter to her? She'll be so glad of it.
quest.fealty.favor.librarian_letter.desc: The librarian of another village and I have argued by letter for years. Take my latest reply to them, would you?
fealty.courier.no_letter: A letter? You don't seem to have it with you.
fealty.courier.person_thanks: A letter from %s! Oh, thank you. It's been so long since I heard from them.
fealty.quest.courier.posted: You post the letter from %s at %s.
fealty.toast.courier_find: Find %s and give them the letter.
fealty.mail.write.title: Write a Letter
fealty.mail.postable: You carry a letter from %s for this mailbox.
fealty.mail.empty: No letters for you. Write to a village you know, or to a friend.
fealty.mail.pick: Pick a letter to read it.
fealty.mail.to_hint: Click to choose who to write to: a village you know, or a player.
fealty.mail.subject: Subject
fealty.mail.problem.paper: You need a sheet of paper to write on.
fealty.mail.problem.postage: Sending %s parcel(s) costs as many emeralds.
fealty.mail.problem.player: No player called %s has been here.
fealty.mail.returned.subject: Returned letter
fealty.mail.returned.body: Your letter could not be delivered: that village is no more.
fealty.mail.reply_letter.subject: Re: your letter
fealty.mail.reply_letter.body: Thank you for your letter, "%2$s". It was read aloud by the hearth in %1$s, and it lifted many hearts.
fealty.mail.reply_gift.subject: Thank you!
fealty.mail.reply_gift.body: Your gift reached %1$s safe and sound. We are grateful, and we will not forget it.
fealty.mail.reply_gift_capped.subject: Thank you again
fealty.mail.reply_gift_capped.body: Another gift! %1$s thanks you, though truly, you have been generous enough for one day.
fealty.mail.reply_hated.subject: Returned unopened
fealty.mail.reply_hated.body: %1$s wants nothing from you. Your letter, and anything with it, is returned unopened.
fealty.mail.trusted.subject: A friend of %s
fealty.mail.trusted.body: The people of %1$s count you a friend. Please accept these small gifts, with our thanks.
fealty.mail.trusted_elder.subject: A friend of %s
fealty.mail.trusted_elder.body: The people of %1$s count you a friend, and so do I. Accept these small gifts. When you next pass by, come and see me: there are old stories I would like to tell you.
fealty.mail.honored.subject: With honour
fealty.mail.honored.body: All of %1$s honours your name. This is a poor token of our gratitude, but it is given with the whole village's thanks.
fealty.mail.hated.subject: A warning
fealty.mail.hated.body: Do not come back to %1$s. Our guards have been told what you are.
fealty.mail.wanted.subject: WANTED
fealty.mail.wanted.body.1: WANTED by %s. A price has been put on your head, and bounty hunters are on your trail.
fealty.mail.wanted.body.2: WANTED by %s. The Tyrant Lord rides to bring you in, dead or alive.
fealty.hall.title: %s · Village Hall
fealty.hall.away: You must be in the village to do this.
fealty.hall.recruit_hint: Swear in a new guard now, in place of the fallen one you picked.
fealty.hall.recruited: A new guard joins the watch.
fealty.hall.feast_desc: Lay on a feast for the whole village: %s food and %s emeralds. The village will love you the more for it, and everyone who comes is welcome. Once a week.
fealty.hall.feast_cost: A feast needs %s food and %s emeralds.
fealty.hall.feast_cooldown: The village is still full from the last feast.
fealty.hall.feast_guest: %s holds a feast in %s, and you are welcome at the table!
fealty.hall.feast_announce: %s holds a feast for all of %s!
fealty.hall.treasury_now: %s bundles of tribute in the treasury
fealty.hall.treasury_rate: About %s a day at the current taxes
fealty.hall.treasury_intro: Tribute is gathered every day, whether you are here or not, and kept for you here, up to a week's worth. Collect it in person. Heavy taxes fill the treasury fast; light ones fill it slowly, but a village that loves you sometimes gathers you a gift of love.
fealty.hall.mood.happy: The people are happy with how you rule.
fealty.hall.mood.grumbling: The people grumble about the taxes.
fealty.hall.mood.angry: The people are angry. The taxes are crushing them.
fealty.hall.taxes_intro: Choose how much to ask of the village.
fealty.hall.tribute_legend: Tribute per day, the change in your standing each day, and the daily chance of a gift of love
fealty.hall.taxes_now_detail: At %s taxes the village gives about %s bundles of tribute a day, and your standing changes by %s a day.
fealty.hall.no_watch: The village has no watch yet. Guards take up their posts when you visit.
fealty.mail.tribute_report.subject: Tribute report
fealty.mail.tribute_report.body: My lord, %2$s bundles of tribute wait for you in the hall at %1$s. The taxes stand at %3$s.
fealty.journal.open_hall_hint: Run this village from afar. Taxes can be set from anywhere; the rest needs you there.
fealty.line.thanks_rescue.any.1: Thank you, %s! I thought I was done for.
fealty.line.thanks_rescue.any.3: That thing came out of nowhere. Thank you!
fealty.line.thanks_healed.any.0: Oh! I feel so much better.
fealty.line.thanks_healed.any.1: Thank you, %s. That stung less than the wound.
fealty.line.thanks_healed.any.3: I'll be back at work in no time. Thank you!
fealty.line.hated_arrival.any.4: Not you again. Get away from here!
fealty.donate.given: You put %s emerald(s) in the %s coffer.
fealty.crime.trespass_warning: You are in someone's home. Leave before they wake.
fealty.fine.demand: Halt! That'll be %s emeralds, or you answer to the watch.
fealty.fine.issued: %s demands a fine of %s emeralds. Talk to them, or press a button below, within %s seconds, or the watch turns on you.
fealty.fine.unpaid: You did not pay the fine. The watch is after you.
fealty.fine.paid: The fine is paid. The watch stands down.
fealty.fine.elder_option: Pay a fine to clear your name (%s emeralds)
fealty.fine.tomorrow: You have paid all the elder will take today. Come back tomorrow.
fealty.fine.elder_paid: So be it. The debt is paid, and we will speak no more of it.
fealty.guard.fine.text: You owe the watch %s emeralds. Pay up, or answer for what you did.
fealty.mail.gossip.subject: Word reaches %s
fealty.mail.gossip.body: %1$s has heard what you did in %2$s. Do not expect a warm welcome here.
fealty.mail.gossip_many.subject: Word reaches %s
fealty.mail.gossip_many.body: Word of what you did in %2$s has reached %1$s and %3$s other villages. Do not expect a warm welcome.
fealty.lock.locked: It's locked. A lockpick might open it.
fealty.lock.coffer: The coffer is locked. Only the lord holds the key... or a lockpick.
fealty.lockpick.title: Pick the lock
fealty.lockpick.hint: Drag the brass knob round the ring to set the pick (or scroll, or use the arrow keys). Click the lock or press Space to turn it: the further it turns, the closer you are. Each try leaves a mark on the ring.
fealty.lockpick.close: Almost! It turns a long way.
fealty.lockpick.broke_spare: Snap! The pick breaks. Take another in hand and try again.
fealty.raid.won.detail: %s is safe, and won't forget who stood with it
fealty.raid.withdrew_loot: The bandits pulled back from %s, carrying what they took back to their camp.
fealty.command.raid_failed: Could not raid %s: it is already under attack, or there is no open ground for raiders to come from.
fealty.banner.gift_of_love.detail: %s has gathered a gift for you
fealty.lord.gifts: Out of love for you, the people of %s give you %s gift(s).
fealty.mail.gift_of_love.subject: With love, from %s
fealty.mail.gift_of_love.body: Your people in %1$s love you, and have gathered a gift for their lord. It waits for you in the treasury: collect it at the Village Hall.
fealty.command.rehomed: The elder of %s now lives at %s, %s, %s. The coffer stays where it was.
fealty.command.rehome_failed: Found no home for the elder of %s. Stand in the village so it is loaded, then try again.
fealty.guard.forgiven: %s frowns at you, but lets it go. Your standing still suffers.
fealty.lord.loved_again: The people of %s are content with their lord again.
fealty.banner.lord_unrest.detail: %s will renounce you in %s days unless you win back their honour.
fealty.mail.lord_unrest.subject: Unrest in %s
fealty.mail.lord_unrest.body: My lord, the people of %1$s grumble in the square: they no longer hold you in honour. Win back their love within %2$s days, or they will renounce their fealty to you.
advancement.fealty.war_declared.desc: Raise your village's warband against a pillager stronghold
advancement.fealty.warlord.desc: Lead your warband to victory over a pillager stronghold
advancement.fealty.stronghold_razed.desc: Fight in a raid that razes a pillager stronghold
advancement.fealty.captive_freed.desc: Free a villager held in a pillager camp
advancement.fealty.liberator.desc: Free ten captives from pillager camps
fealty.captive.freed: %s is free! They thank you and slip away home.
fealty.captive.home: %s villagers freed from the pillagers have come home to %s.
fealty.hall.war.intro: Pillager strongholds near the village: scout camps, camps, outposts, forts and castles. The skulls show how dangerous each is. Send scouts to find them, pick one, and raise the warband: you march with the guards beside you, and the rest of the warband (and a levy of militia) catches up near the stronghold. The harder the stronghold, the bigger the warband, the cost and the spoils. Win, and its captives go free, the treasury fills and the village knows peace.
fealty.hall.war.none: No pillager strongholds are known within reach. Send scouts to look.
fealty.hall.war.scout_hint: Scouts search the land around the village for pillager strongholds. Costs emeralds; once a day.
fealty.hall.war.scouted: The scouts went out today. They will go again tomorrow.
fealty.hall.war.raise_hint: March with the guards beside you; %s more guards and %s militia join you near the stronghold.
fealty.hall.war.call_off_hint: The warband goes home. The village must rest before it marches again.
fealty.hall.war.where_long: %s blocks to the %s of the village.
fealty.war.not_lord: Only the lord of %s can raise its warband.
fealty.war.already: You are already leading a raid.
fealty.war.cooldown: The village rests: %s days until it can march again.
fealty.war.too_far: %s is too far for the warband to march.
fealty.war.razed: %s lies in ashes for %s more days.
fealty.war.no_warband: %s has no one to march: no guards, and too few villagers for a levy.
fealty.war.cost: Arms and food for the warband cost %s emeralds.
fealty.war.quest_full: You have too many tasks in hand to lead a raid.
fealty.war.declared.detail: March on %s. %s fall in behind you.
fealty.war.declared.chat: %s raises its warband against %s. Follow the war map; the rest of the warband will join you near the stronghold.
fealty.war.mustered.detail: %s guards and %s militia have caught up with you.
fealty.war.won.detail: %s is razed. %s captives freed; %s days of peace.
fealty.war.target_gone: The stronghold is gone; the raid is over.
fealty.war.scouted_today: The scouts already went out today.
fealty.war.scout_cost: Scouts need %s emeralds for the road.
fealty.war.scouts_found: The scouts of %2$s return. They found %1$s pillager strongholds:
fealty.war.scouts_none: The scouts of %s found no pillagers within reach.
fealty.war.scouts_nothing_new: The scouts of %s found nothing you did not already know.
fealty.war.ended.lord_died: You fell at %s. The warband carries word home: the raid is lost.
fealty.war.ended.warband_fell: Your warband is broken and you have left the field. The raid on %s is lost.
fealty.war.ended.timed_out: The days for the raid on %s ran out. The warband goes home.
fealty.war.ended.called_off: The raid on %s is called off. The warband goes home.
fealty.war.ended.lordship_lost: You are no longer lord. The raid on %s is over.
fealty.mail.pillager_menace.subject: Pillagers raid %s
fealty.mail.pillager_menace.body: My lord, raiders from %2$s fell upon %1$s. While that stronghold stands they will come again. Raise the warband from the Village Hall and put it to the torch.
fealty.mail.war_victory.subject: %s rejoices
fealty.mail.war_victory.body: My lord, all of %1$s sings of your victory at %2$s. %3$s of our kin have come home, and the treasury holds the spoils.
fealty.mail.problem.refused: The post will not take this letter.
fealty.quest.raid_stronghold.preview: Lead the village's warband against a pillager stronghold.
fealty.quest.free_captives.none: No pillager camp could be found nearby.
fealty.quest.free_captives.line: Free captives from the pillager camp (%s/%s). Break the bars of their cage.
fealty.quest.free_captives.preview: Free %s villagers held in a pillager camp.
fealty.quest.free_captives.done: The captives are free. Return to the elder.
quest.fealty.raid_stronghold.desc: You raised the warband. March on the stronghold, defeat its defenders and free whoever they hold.
quest.fealty.scout_the_pillagers.desc: Pillagers have been seen on the roads. Find where they make camp, so our lord knows where to strike.
quest.fealty.free_the_captives.desc: The pillagers took some of our people and keep them in cages at their camp. Bring them home.
fealty.command.war_list_none: No pillager strongholds are known near here.
fealty.command.war_none: You are not leading a raid.
fealty.command.war_no_menace: No standing stronghold menaces %s, or a raid cannot start there now.
fealty.line.captive_freed.0: You came for us! Bless you!
fealty.line.captive_freed.1: Free... I'm free! I'll tell the whole village.
fealty.line.captive_freed.2: Quick, before they see. I know the way home.
fealty.line.captive_freed.3: I thought no one would come.
fealty.line.home_again.0: Home! I never thought I'd see it again.
fealty.line.home_again.1: Back at last. Our lord's warband freed us.
fealty.line.home_again.2: Is that the bell? We're home!
fealty.line.war_sendoff.1: Burn their camp to the ground!
fealty.line.war_sendoff.2: Gods keep you, and the guards with you.
fealty.line.war_sendoff.3: Show those pillagers what we're made of!
fealty.stronghold.trait.veterans.desc: Its pillagers wear iron and carry enchanted arms.
fealty.stronghold.trait.evoker.desc: An evoker leads it, with fangs and vexes.
fealty.hall.war.defenders_unknown: Held by whatever pillagers are there.
fealty.hall.war.rewards: Razing it wins %s tribute for the treasury and %s days of peace.
advancement.fealty.castle_stormed.desc: Fight in a raid that razes a pillager castle
advancement.fealty.lions_den.desc: Fight in a raid that razes a stronghold of five skulls
fealty.fine.button.pay.hint: Pay the fine of %s emeralds. The watch stands down.
fealty.fine.button.refuse.hint: Refuse to pay. The watch turns on you.
fealty.fine.journal.title: A fine to pay
fealty.fine.journal.text: %s demands %s emeralds. %s seconds left, or the watch turns on you.
fealty.chatter.bagel.0: Did you hear about Gerald and the bagel?
fealty.chatter.bagel.1: The one he slipped on? Poor soul.
fealty.chatter.bagel.tell: We were talking about Gerald. He slipped on a bagel this morning and he's not feeling too well. Don't tell him I told you.
fealty.chatter.knees.0: My knees say it's going to rain.
fealty.chatter.knees.tell: Barnaby swears his knees can predict the weather. They're wrong about half the time, but never about complaining.
fealty.chatter.carrot.0: Mine's the biggest carrot in the village.
fealty.chatter.carrot.tell: We were arguing over whose carrot is bigger. It's a turnip. I won't be told otherwise.
fealty.chatter.golem_sleep.1: I'm not brave enough to ask it.
fealty.chatter.golem_sleep.tell: We were wondering whether the iron golem ever sleeps. Nobody's been brave enough to ask.
fealty.chatter.hat.tell: I lost my hat. It was on my head the whole time. Please forget I said anything.
fealty.chatter.wolves.0: Did you hear the wolves howling?
fealty.chatter.wolves.tell: Wolves have been howling half the night. Mind yourself if you walk out after dark.
fealty.chatter.librarian_book.0: I've read that book three times.
fealty.chatter.librarian_book.1: It's the only one you own.
fealty.chatter.librarian_book.tell: We were joking about the librarian's collection. They've read the same book three times. The ending hasn't changed.
fealty.chatter.cleric_brew.tell: The cleric brewed something that smells like feet. Apparently that's the point.
fealty.chatter.smithy_noise.0: Why is the smith hammering at this hour?
fealty.chatter.smithy_noise.1: Same reason as always: to keep us awake.
fealty.chatter.smithy_noise.tell: We were grumbling about the smithy's hammering. We'd miss it if it stopped, mind.
fealty.chatter.bell.0: The bell rang for nothing again.
fealty.chatter.bell.tell: The bell rang for no reason. It was a bird, apparently. A very pushy bird.
fealty.chatter.bread.tell: We were grumbling about the price of bread. It's always something.
fealty.chatter.cat_well.0: The cat's in the well again.
fealty.chatter.cat_well.tell: Somebody's cat keeps falling into the well. It's fine. Mostly.
fealty.chatter.fish_tale.1: Last week it was the size of a cow.
fealty.chatter.fish_tale.tell: The fisherman's catch gets bigger every time he tells it. We were having a laugh about it.
fealty.chatter.sheep_wink.0: I swear that sheep winked at me.
fealty.chatter.sheep_wink.1: You've been out in the sun too long.
fealty.chatter.sheep_wink.tell: A sheep winked at one of us. It might have been the sun.
fealty.chatter.arrows.0: More arrows gone from the fletcher's.
fealty.chatter.arrows.tell: Arrows keep going missing at the fletcher's. Pillagers, we think. Or very ambitious squirrels.
fealty.chatter.snoring.0: Someone's snoring is shaking the east houses.
fealty.chatter.snoring.tell: Somebody's snoring is the talk of the east houses. I'm not naming names.
fealty.chatter.zombies.1: The guards have it in hand.
fealty.chatter.zombies.tell: Zombies have been prowling at the edge of the village after dark. The guards are on it, but stay indoors if you can.
fealty.chatter.bad_map.0: Where does this road even go?
fealty.chatter.bad_map.tell: The cartographer drew the road wrong again, and we were having a laugh about it.
fealty.chatter.leaning_wall.tell: A wall near the mason's has leaned for years. It hasn't fallen, so nobody fixes it.
fealty.chatter.feast.0: Do you think there'll be a feast this year?
fealty.chatter.feast.1: Only if the lord is feeling generous.
fealty.chatter.feast.tell: We were hoping for a feast. They only happen when the lord is feeling generous.
fealty.chatter.golem_dream.0: I dreamt I was an iron golem last night.
fealty.chatter.golem_dream.tell: One of us dreamt of being an iron golem. A fine dream, apparently, until the cabbages.
fealty.chatter.best_dressed.tell: Our friend in green is sure he's the best-dressed in the village. We let him.
fealty.chatter.crows.0: The crows got my wheat again.
fealty.chatter.crows.2: I did. It's afraid of them.
fealty.chatter.crows.tell: Crows keep raiding the wheat. The scarecrow doesn't help; it seems to be afraid of them.
fealty.chatter.children.tell: We were talking about the children running all over the village. We were just the same.
fealty.chatter.llamas.tell: A wandering trader came by with a string of llamas. He swears they're good company.
fealty.chatter.missing_pie.0: Who ate the pie on the windowsill?
fealty.chatter.missing_pie.tell: A pie vanished from a windowsill. Everybody denies it. I blame the cat.
fealty.chatter.puddle.0: Mind the puddle by the well!
fealty.chatter.puddle.tell: Someone stepped in the big puddle by the well. Their boots are still wet.
fealty.chatter.moon.tell: We were talking about the moon. It looked odd. It always does, if you look long enough.
fealty.chatter.butcher_trade.1: You've said that every day this week.
fealty.chatter.butcher_trade.tell: The butcher says business is looking up. It's been looking up all week.
fealty.chatter.heroes.0: Someone fought off a raid, I heard.
fealty.chatter.heroes.1: A true hero. We could use more of them.
fealty.chatter.heroes.tell: We were talking about heroes. It's good to have a friend with a sword when the pillagers come.
fealty.chatter.stew.tell: We were talking about the stew. I still haven't found out what's in it.
fealty.chatter.lantern.0: Someone walked by the road with a lantern at an odd hour.
fealty.chatter.lantern.tell: Somebody went down the road with a lantern at an odd hour. A traveller, probably. Probably.
fealty.rumour.trivia.0: I slipped and fell on a bagel this morning. I'm not feeling too well.
fealty.rumour.trivia.1: My knees say it'll rain. My knees are hardly ever wrong.
fealty.rumour.trivia.2: I found a button in my soup yesterday. I'm keeping it.
fealty.rumour.trivia.3: Ever notice how a chicken looks at you? It knows something.
fealty.rumour.trivia.4: I tried to count the stars last night. I got to eleven and fell asleep.
fealty.rumour.trivia.5: My neighbour's goat ate his hat. Then his other hat.
fealty.rumour.trivia.6: I'm thinking of growing a beard. Or shrinking my nose. I haven't decided.
fealty.rumour.trivia.7: Some mornings I forget which house is mine.
fealty.rumour.trivia.8: I once saw a cow walk backwards. I never told anyone until now.
fealty.rumour.trivia.9: The bread was a bit stale this morning. I ate it anyway. Don't tell the cook.
fealty.rumour.trivia.10: I named my pig Gerald. Gerald is not a good listener.
fealty.rumour.trivia.11: I swear the well answers back sometimes.
fealty.rumour.trivia.12: I lost a sock last week. It's still lost. I'm at peace with it.
fealty.rumour.trivia.13: Got a splinter from a fence post. Fought it bravely. It won.
fealty.rumour.trivia.14: Never trust anyone who doesn't like pie.
fealty.rumour.trivia.15: I was going to tell you something. It's gone. Odd.
fealty.rumour.trivia.16: Pillagers? No. I've got a rock in my shoe, that's what's wrong with me.
fealty.rumour.trivia.17: They say the golem is afraid of poppies. I gave it one. It's fine.
fealty.rumour.trivia.18: Everyone keeps asking me what's up. The sky, mostly.
fealty.rumour.trivia.19: I don't think hats suit me. I own four.
fealty.rumour.trivia.20: I can't sleep. Every shadow looks like a creeper.
fealty.rumour.trivia.21: Strange noises last night. Probably the cat. Probably.
fealty.rumour.trivia.22: The stars are lovely, but my bed is lovelier.
fealty.rumour.trivia.23: Lovely day for nothing in particular.
fealty.rumour.trivia.24: The sun's out and I've nothing to complain about. How suspicious.
fealty.rumour.trivia.25: The carrots are sulking this year.
fealty.rumour.trivia.26: A scarecrow is the only friend who never argues.
fealty.rumour.trivia.27: I've read every book here twice. The second time I found a different ending.
fealty.rumour.trivia.28: Shh. I'm in the middle of a chapter.
fealty.rumour.trivia.29: My brew bubbled in a way I didn't like. I'm pretending it didn't.
fealty.rumour.trivia.30: Never give a butcher a pun. We've heard them all.
fealty.rumour.trivia.31: A sheep headbutted me this morning. I believe it was personal.
fealty.rumour.trivia.32: Fish never bite when you want them to. Like cats.
fealty.rumour.trivia.33: Hammering is just very loud thinking.
fealty.rumour.trivia.34: A good wall keeps neighbours friendly. Mostly.
fealty.rumour.trivia.35: A feather is a feather. Unless it's a chicken's, then it's an argument.
fealty.rumour.trivia.36: The cow gave me a funny look when I measured it.
fealty.rumour.trivia.37: I drew the village from memory. It came out smaller than I remember.
fealty.rumour.trivia.38: I'm told I'm a nitwit. I'm not sure what that is, but it sounds important.
fealty.rumour.trivia.39: Why do you want to know? Hmph.
fealty.rumour.trivia.40: Nothing to tell you. And if there were, I wouldn't.
fealty.rumour.trivia.41: What's up? Not my opinion of you.
fealty.rumour.refuse.0: I've nothing to say to you.
fealty.rumour.refuse.2: Why would I tell you anything?
fealty.rumour.refuse.5: I'd sooner talk to a zombie.
fealty.chatter.live.stronghold.0.0: Have you heard what they're saying about the land past the hills?
fealty.chatter.live.stronghold.1.0: My cousin saw smoke out beyond the ridge.
fealty.chatter.live.stronghold.1.1: Smoke? Don't say that where the children can hear.
fealty.chatter.live.bandits.0.0: Keep your purse close if you take the road.
fealty.chatter.live.bandits.1.0: A traveller was robbed on the road again.
fealty.chatter.live.bandits.1.1: Dreadful. Those bandits are getting bold.
fealty.chatter.live.guards.0.0: Have you counted the guards lately?
fealty.chatter.live.guards.1.0: The watch looks different these days.
fealty.chatter.live.guards.1.1: Don't say it so loud. They'll hear.
fealty.chatter.live.menace.0.0: Those pillagers are the talk of the market.
fealty.chatter.live.menace.0.1: Aye, and not in a good way.
fealty.chatter.live.menace.1.0: Did you hear? Something's brewing out on the road.
fealty.chatter.live.tax.0.0: Have you seen what the lord is asking this season?
fealty.chatter.live.tax.0.1: I have. Let's not speak of it here.
fealty.chatter.live.tax.1.0: Did you see the new tax notice?
fealty.chatter.live.tax.1.1: I'm trying not to look at it.
fealty.chatter.live.trade.0.0: Did you hear what the trader has been stocking?
fealty.chatter.live.trade.0.1: I have. It's worth a look.
fealty.chatter.live.trade.1.0: Somebody in the village has something special for sale.
fealty.chatter.live.trade.1.1: Ask around. You might be lucky.
fealty.dialogue.option.news_chat: What are you two talking about?
fealty.rumour.stronghold: Folk talk of %1$s, about %2$s blocks %3$s of the village. %4$s
fealty.rumour.noted: %s is now marked on the Village Hall's War tab.
fealty.rumour.threat.1: A small lookout, they say, but pillagers all the same.
fealty.rumour.threat.2: A proper camp. Don't go in unprepared.
fealty.rumour.threat.3: A walled fort. You'd want a warband.
fealty.rumour.threat.4: A castle, if the stories are true. You'd need an army.
fealty.rumour.threat.5: A fortress, and wicked magic besides. Stay well away, unless you're a hero.
fealty.rumour.bandits: Bandits keep a camp about %1$s blocks %2$s of the village. Keep your purse close.
fealty.rumour.guards: We've lost %1$s of our %2$s guards. The watch is thin.
fealty.rumour.guards_full: The watch is at full strength: %s guards, all hale.
fealty.rumour.menace: Pillagers from %1$s, about %2$s blocks %3$s, have been getting bold. Keep an eye on the road.
fealty.rumour.peace: It's been quiet since the raid. %s more days of peace, they say.
fealty.rumour.tax.0: Lord %s takes nothing from us. We'd follow them anywhere.
fealty.rumour.tax.1: Lord %s's taxes are light. Nobody's complaining.
fealty.rumour.tax.2: The taxes are fair enough. We grumble, but we pay.
fealty.rumour.tax.3: The taxes are heavy these days. People mutter in the market.
fealty.rumour.tax.4: Crushing taxes! One more bad harvest and folk will leave. Lord %s should mind it.
fealty.rumour.trade: The %1$s to the %2$s of here has %3$s for sale. Don't say I sent you.
fealty.rumour.favor: The %1$s to the %2$s of here could use a hand today.
fealty.rumour.private: That's private. And not for the likes of you.
fealty.rumour.enough: I've told you all I know today. Ask me again tomorrow.
fealty.rumour.refuse: I've nothing to say to you.
fealty.chain.story.started: A new tale begins. Seek out %s.
fealty.chain.story.complete: The tale is told, and you saw it through to the end.
fealty.chain.giver.offer: "There is more to be done, %s. Will you hear it?"
fealty.chain.villager.waiting: "Not yet. Come back when the time is right."
